scope: Carnarvon commissioner and former current-office roster only; election timings and unnamed unopposed ward results retained.

sources.title: Local Government (Carnarvon - Declaration of Vacancies and Appointment of Commissioner) Order 2026
sources.method: Official Gazette PDF text independently read, pages 1-2, clauses 2, 4-6.
sources.finding: Clauses 4 and 5 commence the day after Gazette publication: remaining council offices declared vacant and Martin Aldridge appointed commissioner on 27 May 2026. His appointment continues until the offices are filled and the new council holds its first meeting. The order fixes 3 December 2026 for any necessary poll. No individual resignation dates are inferred.

sources.title: Shire of Carnarvon Commissioner
sources.finding: The current official page names Martin Aldridge as Commissioner, performing the functions of the Council and Shire President. It does not describe him as an elected councillor.

limits: Individual earlier resignation dates not checked.
October unopposed ward outcomes remain separate from current governing authority; identities and commencement are not inferred.
Polling day does not automatically end the commissioner appointment.
